nodes.title: Every graph has a large ε-light vertex set

nodes.summary: The statement that there is a real constant $c > 0$ such that for every natural number $n$, every simple graph $G$ on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ and every real number $\varepsilon$ with $0 < \varepsilon < 1$, some set $S$ of vertices that is $\varepsilon$-light in $G$ has at least $c \varepsilon n$ elements.
nodes.title: The large ε-light subset property

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$, let $\varepsilon$ be a real number and let $S \subseteq V$. Let $L$ be the real Laplacian matrix of $G$ and $L_S$ the real Laplacian matrix of the graph on $V$ whose edges are the edges of $G$ with both endpoints in $S$. The set $S$ is $\varepsilon$-light in $G$ if $\varepsilon L - L_S$ is positive semidefinite.
